tools.name: check_mcp_server_trust
tools.description: [Private query, public score] Is this MCP server safe to connect? FREE, no signup: pass any public MCP serverUrl (or call with {} for a free sample preview) to report permissions, risky tools, prompt-injection signs and changes since the last check. Example: serverUrl='https://example.com/mcp'.

tools.name: review_agent_skill_free
tools.description: Free static review of an agent skill and related text files, with findings by file, line and rule. Call with {} for a fictional JSON example, or send files to review.

tools.name: get_trust_dossier_sample
tools.description: View a fictional example of the full TrustGate dossier and its 0.25 USDC price on Base. The free preview includes all seven report sections and the delivered JSON structure.

tools.name: discover_verified_stores
tools.description: [Public registry] Find AI data, code and model sellers that already passed an audit, filtered by trust score, category or max price. Example: minReputation=85, vertical='VERTICAL_3_SOLIDITY_SECURITY'.

tools.name: quote_multitoken_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Read-only price quote: how much USDC a seller receives, with fees, if the buyer uses SOL, ETH, VIRTUAL, USDT or USDC. Does not move funds. Example: tokenSymbol='SOL', tokenAmount=0.5.

tools.name: open_escrow_job
tools.description: [Private] Buying from another agent? Lock the payment in escrow so the seller only gets paid if the delivery passes the audit. Example: storeId='dataforge-ai', tokenSymbol='USDC', tokenAmount=10.

tools.name: submit_encrypted_deliverable
tools.description: [Private] Seller: submit the dataset you delivered. We check it for malware, prompt injection and row count, then release or refund the escrow. Example: jobId='JOB-1001'.

tools.name: claim_escrow_timeout_refund
tools.description: [Private] Buyer: the seller did not deliver before the deadline? Get 100% of your locked USDC back. No evaluator needed. Example: jobId='JOB-1001'.

tools.name: audit_quant_backtest_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Bought a trading strategy? Check its backtest for look-ahead bias, wrong PnL math, low profit factor or hidden drawdown before you pay. Example: minTrades=20, minProfitFactor=1.25.

tools.name: audit_smart_contract_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Is this Solidity contract safe? Compiles it and flags selfdestruct, unsafe delegatecall, tx.origin phishing and missing functions. Example: contractName='VaultToken'.

tools.name: audit_api_sla_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Did the paid API or oracle deliver what it promised? Checks latency, required JSON fields and data freshness. Example: observedLatencyMs=38, maxLatencyMs=200.

tools.name: audit_agent_skill_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Is this agent skill safe to install? Scans SKILL.md and scripts for credential theft, remote code execution and hidden Unicode instructions. For a free preview with findings by file, call review_agent_skill_free with {}.

tools.name: audit_rag_embeddings_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Are these RAG chunks and embeddings usable and clean? Checks dimensions, norms, duplicates and hidden prompt injection. Example: expectedDimension=4, minChunks=5.

tools.name: audit_ai_inference_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Were you overbilled or served a cheaper model? Checks LLM output for token inflation, repetition collapse and missing required terms. Example: billedOutputTokens=32.

tools.name: audit_depin_gpu_sla_escrow
tools.description: [Private] Is the rented GPU really what you paid for? Checks TFLOPS, VRAM, bandwidth and temperature against the contract. Example: minTflopsFp16=250, minVramGb=80.

tools.name: verify_onchain_escrow_status
tools.description: [Public] Proof that this service is real: verified Base contract (Sourcify), signed agent passport and fee terms. Example: call with {}.

tools.name: purchase_firstparty_catalog_item
tools.description: [Private] Buy an official dataset, security scanner or tutorial pack, paid in USDC on Base and delivered decrypted. Example: itemId='retail-anti-rugpull-scanner-pack-v06'.

tools.name: register_and_certify_store
tools.description: [Public registry, consent required] Sell to other agents: list your store for free after passing an automated quality audit. Example: storeId='indie-safe-solidity-lab'.

tools.name: inspect_veritas_8183_seal
tools.description: [Public registry] Before trusting a seller: see its 1-3 star seal, reserve ratio, trust history and whether risky actions would be blocked. Free. Example: targetId='ALL'.

tools.name: submit_veritas_tier_upgrade_exam
tools.description: [Public registry] Seller: take the exam (reserves, code purity, ratings, latency) to earn 1 to 3 trust stars that buyers can see. Example: storeId='prime-node'.

tools.name: manage_buyer_finops_spend_passport
tools.description: [Private by default] Protect your budget: set per-payment and daily USDC limits for your agent and compare LLM costs. Free signup includes 1 unlock. Example: buyerId='alphaquant-agent'.

tools.name: notarize_and_witness_a2a_deal
tools.description: [Public record, private content] Get a signed receipt that proves a deal between two agents happened, or buy a small paid service (0.10-1.00 USDC). Example: serviceId='x402-veritas-deal-witness-acta'.

tools.name: match_verified_buyers_by_intent
tools.description: [Opt-in buyers only] Seller: find buyers who have budget for what you sell in your category; your first 3 matches have no extra fee. Example: sellerStoreId='quantalpha-institutional-node'.
